title: A CMOS Direct Injection-Locked Oscillator Topology as High-Frequency Low-Power Frequency Divider
type: CMOS Direct Injection-Locked Oscillator Topology as High-Frequency Low-Power Frequency Divider
function_summary: CMOS Direct Injection-Locked Oscillator Topology as High-Frequency Low-Power Frequency Divider: An injection-locked oscillator topology is presented, based on MOS switches directly coupled to the tank of well-known oscillators.
